headline: Microsoft flags M365 outage-lure phishing wave; Infoblox SharePoint breach; PHP2Shell hits Check Point gateways

bullets.text: New: Microsoft warns of a high-volume phishing campaign that uses Microsoft 365 outage lures to target organizations across multiple industry sectors.

Still active: Google says Russian-speaking hackers ran the first fully automated AI cyberattack (CyberScoop), and reports an AI agent turned a security patch into a working exploit with no human help. Dark Reading says China-nexus actors breached 10 organizations in AI-driven attacks.

Still active: Infoblox confirms hackers accessed company information (TechCrunch); The Register reports customer and staff data was exposed through a SharePoint breach. No CVE or wider attack vector is given yet.

Still active: Barracuda links its cloud breach to the ARTEX AI-powered attack tool, per BleepingComputer. Barracuda CVE-2026-111560 and ESG CVE-2026-116606 went on KEV 11-10 and are past their 11-13 deadline.

Still active, critical: a PHP2Shell flaw is exploited in chained attacks on unpatched Check Point gateways (no CVE given). Check Point CVE-2026-123039 and exploited UnrealIRCd CVE-2026-114713 reached their KEV deadline on 11-16.

Breaches: Uber says hackers stole information on close to 150,000 driver's licenses; Fandango checkout card theft, Coles and Lithuania's customs agency are also on the board. SITCON 3 unchanged; 7-day score is 0.7x the 90-day average; n0n (79) and INC Ransom (53) lead leak-site claims.

actions: Warn staff that Microsoft 365 outage notices may be phishing; check the official service health page and report outage-themed lures.
Barracuda customers: patch CVE-2026-111560 and ESG CVE-2026-116606 now, review cloud account access and follow Barracuda's breach advisory.
Check Point gateways: apply all current fixes including CVE-2026-123039, restrict management access and hunt for PHP2Shell chained compromise.
Infoblox customers: watch for breach notices, treat unexpected Infoblox-themed mail as phishing, and review credentials or contacts shared with them.
LiteLLM and Starlette: patch CVE-2026-42271 and CVE-2026-48710 (SANS sees scans), keep admin endpoints private and rotate stored API keys.
Queue KEV fixes: Apple CVE-2024-27834 due 11-18, SonicWall SSLVPN 11-20, Outlook, Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave and Chromium 11-24.
